name: Desucon
blurb: A Finnish anime convention in Lahti held twice a year: the main Desucon in June and the winter spin-off Desucon Frostbite in January.
notes: desucon.fi's shared page template crashed the extract tool (an SVG <a> element made 'a.href' a non-string); fixed in pipeline/tools/extract.mjs (coerce to a plain string / .baseVal before using it) so both this and other agents' renders of similar pages stop failing. Desucon runs two editions a year under one brand in one city (Lahti): both upcoming ones are listed. Frostbite 2027's sole announced Guest of Honor (Yūki Hayashi) came from its own announcement post (.../frostbite2027/uutiset/2026/09/kunniavieraaksi-Yuki-Hayashi/), the only guest-facing page found; cat/known-for are inferred from that post's own wording ('säveltäjä' = composer). The June 2027 edition's venue (Sibeliustalo) is inferred from Frostbite's confirmed venue plus independent confirmation that past June Desucon editions used Sibeliustalo too; not independently re-confirmed for 2027 specifically. No guests announced yet for June 2027. Verify pass (2026-10-05): confirmed current for Frostbite 2027 -- the guest page is itself a dedicated announcement post titled '...Frostbiten 2027 kunniavieraaksi Yuki Hayashi - Frostbite 2027' (5.9.2026), and the site's own news sidebar keeps 'Frostbite 2027', 'Desucon 2026' and 'Desucon 2025' as separate tags, so there is no mixing with a prior year. Refute pass (2026-10-05): fresh re-extraction confirms the same dated announcement post ('Desucon Frostbiten 2027 kunniavieraaksi Yūki Hayashi', 5.9.2026) still sits in the site's own news feed alongside other September 2026 Frostbite-2027-specific posts (job/programme applications, cosplay contest openings), so this is an actively maintained 2027 page, not a leftover; lineup upheld.
